OpenLF2

Press Start game to download the original LF2 v2.0a game data (about 30 MB, checked by SHA-256) from the online relay when it keeps a copy, else from archive.org, or select your own LF2_v2.0a.exe or lf2_v20a_Setup.exe installer manually. Your browser saves the installer for future visits; a selected file is not uploaded to a server.
